evidence.title: Chindata Commences Commercial Operation of an SST-Based DC Power System for Hyperscale Data Centers
evidence.operational_environment: Chindata Sangyuan Cloud Computing Campus near Beijing
evidence.architecture: 10kV utility AC to 800VDC using an SST-based intelligent DC power system
claim_summary: The named operator reported commencement of commercial operation at a named cloud-computing campus.
The system uses a 10kV-to-800VDC SST architecture for hyperscale AI infrastructure.
The operator reported that the project entered commercial operation after 34 performance and safety validation tests.
evidence.decision_use: Makes R5 field-deployment evidence available for CML review; does not itself mutate readiness.
limitations: The record is an attributable operator publication, not an independent third-party audit.
The L1 review did not independently verify performance or efficiency figures.
The L1 result does not establish operating history, multi-entity replication, or PDRE-001A application qualification.
Human/CML review is required before any CML state change.
